  * Characterized by impostor syndrome
  * Requires active mental energy
  * "Faking it till you make it" phase
  * Mental drain only
* Stage 4: Unconscious Competence
  * True mastery
  * No additional mental energy required
  * Natural and automatic execution
  * Flexible and adaptable performance

Personal Philosophy

* Balance between savoring success and continuing growth
* Emphasis on sustainable progress over speed
* Taking responsibility for personal development
* Focus on building lasting improvements
